answer_1.quote: In this paper, we revisit edit-based linguistic steganography. Our key idea is that a masked language model (masked LM), which was first introduced with BERT , offers an off-the-shelf solution.

answer_2.quote: For each stegosystem, we fine-tuned the same BERT Base, Cased model on the binary classification task.

answer_4.quote: We asked Amazon Mechanical Turk workers to give 5-point scale ratings on the stego and real texts according to naturality and correctness.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to rate texts (each question had 5 texts) with a Likert scale from 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).
